triggerReasons.message: Request has a structural multi-deliverable signal, so milestone coverage must be countable.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The pilot evidence root under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/ contains protocol.json (validated), score-records.jsonl (both arms, >=15 control fault runs, zero voided, replay byte-identical), leakage-audit.jsonl (all clean), and n-freeze.json whose frozen N equals sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck output for the recorded baseline.
acceptanceBindings.note: M6 exit criteria bound to the four checklist items.

diagnosticGaps.message: Milestone triggers exist but no milestone ledger is configured.
Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present.
Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation.
Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured.
